releaseNotes.headline: Claude app limits, a steadier rail
releaseNotes.summary: Version 0.2.16 can use fresh readings from the running Claude app and improves quota refresh, docking, and connections.

highlights.title: Claude desktop limits
highlights.detail: Use recent readings from the running Claude app when Claude Code cannot supply limits.

highlights.title: Claude pauses preserved
highlights.detail: Request and Keychain pauses stay in place while Claude app readings are shown.

highlights.title: Steadier live limits
highlights.detail: Codex keeps newer push updates. Cursor waits for a busy database before reading sign-in.

highlights.title: More reliable windows
highlights.detail: Docked positions survive unplugging, Settings fits its screen, and Sign In cancels cleanly.
